Its first stage is SDV: `data_generation/data_generation.py` builds a `SingleTableMetadata` and fits a `GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` to produce the dataset the rest of the pipeline consumes. SDV's copula synthesizer is run as the pipeline's data source.

title: PWS Cup 2024 attack scripts
summary: A team's attack-phase notebooks for PWS Cup 2024, the Japanese anonymisation contest, one notebook per attacker and method. The sixth is a generative attack: `attack_06_gan_ctgan.ipynb` builds a `SingleTableMetadata`, fits a `CTGANSynthesizer` on the released anonymised table and uses `sdv.evaluation.evaluate` to judge how closely the reconstruction tracks it. SDV's CTGAN is run as the attack model, on the other side of the contest from the reference synthesiser in the 2026 kit.

title: Pediatric cancer prognosis
summary: A staged analysis improving prognosis prediction for paediatric cancer, moving from data processing through imputation to modelling. The second stage combines imputation with generation: `2-Impute_genai_generate_synthetic_data.ipynb` builds a `SingleTableMetadata` and fits a `CTGANSynthesizer` over the cohort. SDV's CTGAN is run to fill out a small paediatric cohort before the prognosis models are fitted.

title: Peptide synthesis research
summary: A pipeline for generating and evaluating synthetic peptide data for heart-failure and chronic-kidney-disease biomarker analysis, with privacy risk assessment attached. It extends SDV rather than calling it: `custom_copula_synthesizer.py` defines a `CustomGaussianCopulaSynthesizer` subclassing `sdv.single_table.GaussianCopulaSynthesizer` with univariates built on `copulas.univariate`'s `BoundedType`, `ParametricType` and `ScipyModel` base classes, while `src/models/ctgan/gan_interface.py` wraps `CTGANSynthesizer` over `SingleTableMetadata`, and `src/models/copulas` and `src/models/ctgan` sit in-tree. SDV's copula synthesizer is subclassed to carry domain-specific marginals.

title: Permutation-aided fine-tuning (PAFT)
summary: The implementation of PAFT, which fine-tunes a language model for tabular generation under a functional-dependency-aware column permutation, with six evaluation datasets included. SDV appears on both sides of the experiment: `baselines/synthesis_ctgan.py` imports `CTGAN` from `ctgan` and `baselines/synthesis_copula.py` fits a `CopulaGANSynthesizer` over `SingleTableMetadata`, while the rule-check notebook scores everything with SDMetrics' `QualityReport` and the vendored TabSyn baseline pins `sdmetrics` and `rdt`. SDV's models are run as compared baselines and SDMetrics as the scorecard.

title: Pred-LLM
summary: Implementation of Pred-LLM (ICDM 2024), which fine-tunes a pre-trained language model on a real table, samples synthetic rows conditioned on each feature, and then prompts the model for their labels. The conda freeze in `requirements.txt` records `sdv 0.18.0`, `ctgan 0.7.1`, `rdt 1.4.0`, `sdmetrics 0.9.3` and `copulas 0.8.0`, but nothing in the repository imports them; the README credits synthcity for the evaluation code, which is the likely reason the family is installed at all.
